amatsuokamiofthedivinepeaks.name: Amatsu-Okami of the Divine Peaks
amatsuokamiofthedivinepeaks.desc:
3+ Dragon Effect Monsters
Must be Link Summoned. If this Extra Linked card attacks your opponent directly and reduces their LP to 0, you win the Match.

bystialmagnamhut.name: Bystial Magnamhut
bystialmagnamhut.desc: You can target 1 LIGHT or DARK monster in either GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand. This is a Quick Effect if your opponent controls a monster. If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Dragon monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Bystial Magnamhut". You can only use each effect of "Bystial Magnamhut" once per turn.

chainthrasher.name: Chain Thrasher
chainthrasher.desc: This card can attack 1 additional time during the same Battle Phase for each "Chain Thrasher" in your Graveyard.

chimeratechoverdragon.name: Chimeratech Overdragon
chimeratechoverdragon.desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Send all other cards you control to the GY. The original ATK/DEF of this card each become equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon x 800. Each turn, this card can attack your opponent's monsters a number of times equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon.

curseofdragon.name: Curse of Dragon
curseofdragon.desc: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

dinomorphiafrenzy.name: Dinomorphia Frenzy
dinomorphiafrenzy.desc: During your opponent's Main Phase: Pay half your LP; Fusion Summon 1 "Dinomorphia" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using only 1 monster from your Deck and 1 monster from your Extra Deck as Fusion Material. When your opponent activates a card or effect, while your LP are 2000 or less: You can banish this card from your GY; you take no effect damage from your opponent's card effects this turn. You can only activate 1 "Dinomorphia Frenzy" per turn.

doubledragondescent.name: Double Dragon Descent
doubledragondescent.desc: When an opponent's Xyz Monster declares a direct attack: Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon-Type Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck in Attack Position, then the attacking monster attacks it instead, and you proceed to damage calculation. Its ATK becomes equal to the attacking monster's, also its effects are negated. You can only activate 1 "Double Dragon Descent" per turn.

dragunityquirinus.name: Dragunity Quirinus
dragunityquirinus.desc: Your "Dragunity" monsters cannot be destroyed by battle while this card is equipped with an Equip Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dragunity Quirinus" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Dragunity" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 other "Dragunity" Monster Card you control; return it to the hand/Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Dragunity" monster from your hand.

dreammirrorofjoy.name: Dream Mirror of Joy
dreammirrorofjoy.desc: During the End Phase: You can banish this card; activate 1 "Dream Mirror of Terror" directly from your hand or Deck. You can only use this effect of "Dream Mirror of Joy" once per turn. "Dream Mirror" monsters you control cannot be targeted by your opponent's card effects, or their monsters' attacks, except your "Dream Mirror" monster(s) with the highest Level. This effect is only applied while you control a LIGHT "Dream Mirror" monster.

dreiathiiithetruedracocavalrygeneral.name: Dreiath III, the True Dracocavalry General
dreiathiiithetruedracocavalrygeneral.desc: To Tribute Summon this card face-up, you can Tribute a Continuous Spell/Trap Card you control, instead of a monster. Your opponent cannot target face-up "True Draco" or "True King" monsters on the field with card effects, except this one, also they cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If this face-up Tribute Summoned monster leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "True Draco" or "True King" monster from your Deck in Defense Position.

fabledleviathan.name: Fabled Leviathan
fabledleviathan.desc:
1 "Fabled" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target up to 3 "Fabled" monsters in your GY; add them to your hand.

gaiaprominencethefierceforce.name: Gaia Prominence, the Fierce Force
gaiaprominencethefierceforce.desc:
"Gaia Blaze, the Force of the Sun" + 1 face-up monster you control
When your opponent activates a monster effect in their hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 monster; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. When this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can target 1 FIRE monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Gaia Prominence, the Fierce Force" once per turn.

goldpridethatcameoutofnowhere.name: Gold Pride - That Came Out of Nowhere!
goldpridethatcameoutofnowhere.desc: Special Summon 1 "Gold Pride" monster from your hand or GY, then your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand or GY to their field, but negate its effects. You can only activate 1 "Gold Pride - That Came Out of Nowhere!" per turn.

hieraticdragonofeset.name: Hieratic Dragon of Eset
hieraticdragonofeset.desc: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1000. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Dragon-Type Normal Monster on the field; the Levels of all face-up "Hieratic" monsters currently on the field become the Level of that monster, until the End Phase. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

lairwire.name: Lair Wire
lairwire.desc: Remove from play 1 Insect-Type monster from your Graveyard and select 1 monster your opponent controls. Destroy the selected monster.

mementotlanghattic.name: Mementotlan Ghattic
mementotlanghattic.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Memento" card in your GY, except "Mementotlan Ghattic"; add it to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY by a "Memento" monster's effect: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Mementotlan Ghattic" once per turn.

satellarknightprocyon.name: Satellarknight Procyon
satellarknightprocyon.desc: If this card is Summoned: You can send 1 "tellarknight" monster from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Satellarknight Procyon" once per turn.

skystrikeracezero.name: Sky Striker Ace = Zero
skystrikeracezero.desc:
2 "Sky Striker Ace" monsters
You can only Special Summon "Sky Striker Ace = Zero(s)" once per turn. Cannot be used as Link Material. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sky Striker" Spell from your Deck or GY to your hand. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Sky Striker Ace - Raye" and 1 "Sky Striker Ace - Roze" from your Deck and/or GY, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use 1 "Sky Striker Ace = Zero" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

spellreclamation.name: Spell Reclamation
spellreclamation.desc: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Spell Card you activated. Whenever that Spell Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

stardustmirage.name: Stardust Mirage
stardustmirage.desc: If you control a Level 8 or higher Dragon Synchro Monster: Special Summon as many monsters as possible from your GY that were destroyed and sent to your GY by battle or an opponent's card effect this turn. You can only activate 1 "Stardust Mirage" per turn.

tistinathedivinitythatdefiesdarkness.name: Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness
tistinathedivinitythatdefiesdarkness.desc:
2 Level 10 monsters
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send all face-down cards your opponent controls to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Tistina, the Divinity that Defies Darkness" once per turn. Once per turn, if this card has "Crystal God Tistina" as material: You can detach 1 material from this card; it gains 2000 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. If this card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card while it has material: You can Special Summon 1 "Tistina" monster from your GY.

warrockgactos.name: War Rock Gactos
warrockgactos.desc: If an EARTH Warrior monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent from your Monster Zone to your GY by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "War Rock" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only use this effect of "War Rock Gactos" once per turn.

worldlegacyguardragonmardark.name: World Legacy Guardragon Mardark
worldlegacyguardragonmardark.desc:
All monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK/DEF for each Dragon monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "World Legacy Guardragon Mardark" once per turn.
● You can banish 2 Normal Monsters from your hand or GY; Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can add, from your GY to your hand, 1 Level 9 monster with a different original Type and Attribute than this card.

zombiepowerstruggle.name: Zombie Power Struggle
zombiepowerstruggle.desc: Target 1 Zombie monster on the field; until the end of this turn, it gains 1000 ATK or loses 1000 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 1 of your banished Zombie monsters into the Deck, and if you do, Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Zombie Power Struggle" once per turn.
